New Life · Image review · September 8, 2026

Brighter images, a warmer welcome.

The main pages have avoidable dark overlays. The ministry collection also uses dark source artwork, so removing a filter alone will not change its tone.

Prepared in the local preview, not yet live: lighter homepage, Watch, Beliefs, staff portraits and signature cards. The family-card overlay is removed entirely because its text sits below the image. Children’s replacement art remains a draft awaiting approval.

Other ministry artwork

The nine signature cards also reuse existing worship, prayer, Jesus-at-dawn, mission and unity artwork. These remain symbolic images. The current change reduces their shared overlay; it does not present generated scenes as photos of our actual ministries.

Verified against the ministry art map, the ministry-family filter, signature-card mapping, direct source images and the local page preview. Existing ministry files are preserved. New generated artwork requires approval of the specific image before publication.
